newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Asian Terminals gets new port facilities.
newsitem.headline: Asian Terminals gets new port facilities.

text.p: Asian Terminals Inc said on Wednesday it had expanded its equipment fleet after buying 30 forklift units which would help increase its port efficiency.
Asian Terminals is the container terminal and multi-cargo operator at Manila's South Harbour port.
Twelve of the new forklifts will have a carrying load of 10 tonnes, while the rest can lift three, five and fifteen tonnes. The new equipment raises the number of ATI's forklifts to 121.

"ATI is actively investing in this new equipment to fully capitalise on the bright outlook for the country's economic growth in general, and general cargo movement in particular, for the rest of the year," ATI head of General Operations Bonifacio Lomotan said in a statement.
